source: Typed braces: {0}, {1}, {2}, {3} and {4}. The name is the part before {5} or {6}, so {7} in the base locale and {8} in a translation match. Plural parts such as {9} are not placeholders.
text: 带类型的花括号：{0}、{1}、{2}、{3} 和 {4}。名称是 {5} 或 {6} 之前的部分，因此基础语言中的 {7} 与译文中的 {8} 可以匹配。像 {9} 这样的复数部分不是占位符。
